html:
Israel is a state on the eastern shore of the Mediterranean, declared on 14 May 1948 as a Jewish state. The map shows its area from 1938, when it was still part of British Mandatory Palestine.

The state grew out of Zionism, the movement for a Jewish homeland in the land of ancient Israel and Judah. After the UN voted to partition Palestine in 1947, war broke out. Israel declared independence and beat the armies of its Arab neighbours in the first Arab-Israeli war. Some 700,000 Palestinians fled or were expelled, the Nakba. Its first prime minister was David Ben-Gurion.

In the Six-Day War of 1967 Israel took the West Bank, East Jerusalem, Gaza, the Golan Heights and Sinai. It fought Egypt and Syria again in 1973. Egypt made peace in 1979, returning Sinai, and Jordan in 1994. The Palestinian uprisings and the Oslo Accords of 1993 did not settle the conflict over the occupied lands, which has led to repeated wars, most recently in Gaza from 2023.
sum: Israel is a state on the eastern shore of the Mediterranean, declared on 14 May 1948 as a Jewish state. The map shows its area from 1938, when it was still part of British Mandatory Palestine.
